messages:
matt: PagerDuty flood — seeing ~220 alerts for gpu-pool-high-err-rate in the last 10m, PD is paging SRE rotations. Anyone on-call?
incident-bot: Alert flood detected. Auto-created incident INC-2026-134. Initial paging; suppressing duplicate pages after 30s to reduce noise.
priya: I'm on it, jumping in. Can someone check recent deploys and shard distribution? @ashley @matt
ashley: No prod deploys in last hour. quick grep points to model-serving-eu-3 replicas spiking errors.
matt: Graphs confirm a sharp error_rate bump starting ~10:12 UTC. Looks like error bursts from the model loader in that shard. I'm going to add a temporary dedupe/silence to stop PD storms. Patch snippet I plan to apply: 
```
alert: GPUModelErrorRateHigh
expr: sum(rate(model_errors[5m])) by (instance) > 50
for: 1m
labels:
  severity: critical
annotations:
  runbook: /runbooks/gpu_errors
# temp squelch: dedupe duplicates within 10m to avoid pages
squelch:
  dedupe: 10m
```
priya: Applied silence via /ops-alerts UI (silence id SLC-832). PD spam dropped, thanks.
ashley: Investigating logs now. Seeing repeated OOM-ish traces from the model loader when loading a specific quantized shard. Pushing a rolling restart to model-serving-eu-3.
incident-bot: Deploy-bot: rolling restart of model-serving-eu-3 initiated by @ashley (commit d12f3a).
matt: After the rolling restart error rate trending back to baseline over last 7 minutes. PD alerts down to <5. Will keep the dedupe short-lived for now.
julien: Customer impact check: support logs show 3 failed inference calls during the spike window — transient 500s, no data corruption. Notifying support ops FYI, not creating escalated incident.
priya: Good. Handoff plan: I'll document the mitigation and hand over to @julien in 30m. Created pinned note and dashboards: https://redwood.app/dash/987 (live error_rate, grouped alerts, dedupe-hit-rate).
ashley: Follow-up ticket created TKT-558: "Alert tuning for model-serving errors". Proposed actions: group alerts by instance, add rate_limit 5/min per alert group, and auto-squelch on >100 alerts/5m. PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/ops/pull/1223
matt: Post-incident action items I will own: 1) implement dedupe + grouping in alerts (PR review) 2) short-term auto-squelch rule for flood thresholds 3) add dashboard panels for dedupe metrics.
julien: I'll take runbook updates and make sure handoff notes are in the oncall playbook.
priya: Thanks all — closing active paging. Will convert INC-2026-134 to a postmortem ticket and link TKT-558. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-134 status set to "mitigated" by @priya. Postmortem ticket TKT-559 created.
matt: Leaving this thread for the next oncall; ping me in #eng-sre if anything resurfaces.
priya: Handoff completed to @julien (in 25m). Thread will be archived after postmortem is linked.
julien: Acknowledged. I'll monitor overnight and follow the action items in TKT-558 and TKT-559.
